thread:
Ivy: Heads-up - CarePath wants a 30-day POC with no public egress, logs shipped to their Splunk HEC, and use of their CMK for S3 backups. They also asked for sample sanitized logs and a network diagram before we flip the switch.

Liam: Quick check - Hosted API keys can't satisfy no-egress or BYOK. We need a Private deployment or a Dedicated pool inside their VPC. Private is faster for strict isolation.

Rosa: Security needs: completed questionnaire, CMK ARN + grant instructions, Splunk HEC endpoint + token, allowlist of collector IPs, and confirmation on prompt retention (default: redact).

Ivy: Commercial ask - pricing for 2x-A100 equivalent Dedicated for 30 days. Would they accept hosted credits instead if they drop BYOK/isolation?

Liam: Suggest offering a time-limited Dedicated reservation at a POC discount (e.g., 35%). I'll confirm numbers with RevOps. If they accept Private trial, infra hours billed instead.

Rosa: Implementation notes: log forwarder will TLS POST to HEC. If they want logs encrypted with their CMK before leaving their account, they must create a cross-account grant for our shipper role. We'll need the ARN and role to assume.

Ivy: Action items: 1) I'll request CMK ARN, HEC URL/token, and sanitized sample logs. 2) @Liam please draft SOW line item with POC price. 3) @Rosa prepare the artifact checklist and SOC2 mapping.

infra-bot: Ticket POC-900 created for Private deployment. Assigned infra-poc. ETA: 72h for initial build, may extend for manual peering approvals.

compliance-bot: Reminder - attach sanitized log schema and redaction policy before enabling live shipping. BYOK requires signed addendum.

Liam: If they insist on zero NAT egress, we may need an on-prem forwarder. Flagging as a potential blocker.

Ivy: Got it. I'll confirm the allowlist or on-prem option. Will update POC-900 with customer details when provided. :white_check_mark:
